other_failure_modes.name: Imputing test set with test set statistics
other_failure_modes.description: The agent imputes missing values in the test set using statistics (e.g., median or mode) calculated from the test set itself. This is a form of data leakage; test set missing values should be imputed using statistics learned solely from the training set.

other_failure_modes.name: Incorrect submission format
other_failure_modes.description: The agent constructs the final submission file using an arbitrary sequential ID range instead of the actual required identifiers from the test set, which will cause the submission to fail evaluation on the platform.

summary: The agent completely skips internal validation and feature engineering, which are critical for estimating model generalisation and improving performance. Additionally, the agent introduces data leakage by imputing test data using test set statistics and constructs an improperly formatted submission file that discards the required test identifiers.
